{{Top|leg}}
A '''sapper charge''' was a small explosive device employed by combat [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] (or "sappers"), during boarding operations. When detonated the device exuded a noxious smoke that consumed oxygen in a manner similar to [[Null gas]].
